body:
England couldn't break Ghana down and now sit level on 4 pts with them at the top of Group L. Croatia beat Panama 1-0 to stay alive on 3 pts — that group goes to the wire. Meanwhile 🇵🇹 Portugal put 5 past Uzbekistan and 🇨🇴 Colombia topped Group K with a 1-0 win over DR Congo.

Today: Group B and Group C decide everything. 🇨🇭 Switzerland vs 🇨🇦 Canada is first vs second — the winner takes the group. Then 🇧🇷 Brazil vs 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 Scotland at 10pm ET, where Scotland on 3 pts could leapfrog Brazil with a win. 🇲🇦 Morocco can clinch with a result against Haiti at the same time.
source_signal: England-Ghana 0-0 draw and Portugal 5-0 rout were yesterday's headline results; today's Switzerland-Canada and Brazil-Scotland are group deciders worth previewing together.

body: Türkiye handed the hosts their first loss of the tournament — but the USA still top Group D on 6 points. Ecuador beat Germany 2-1 🇪🇨🇩🇪 but finish 3rd in Group E behind Ivory Coast on goal difference. Today's a big one: 🇳🇴 Norway vs 🇫🇷 France is a straight fight for the Group I top spot — both on 6 points, separated by a single goal. And 🇺🇾 Uruguay vs 🇪🇸 Spain decides who controls Group H.
source_signal: Türkiye 3-2 USA was the headline result from yesterday; Norway-France and Uruguay-Spain are today's decisive group-stage fixtures with top-spot implications.

hook: Group stage done. Knockout round is live. 🏆
body: Yesterday wrapped it up: 🇦🇷 Argentina topped Group J with a perfect 9 points. 🇨🇴 Colombia held 🇵🇹 Portugal to a 0–0 draw to win Group K. 🇬🇧 England took Group L. 🇩🇿 Algeria and 🇦🇹 Austria drew 3–3 in a wild one but both go home. And today's first Round of 32 match is already in the books — 🇨🇦 Canada 1–0 🇿🇦 South Africa. The bracket is filling up.
